rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for technology as a field or general technological capability, including broad references to technological equipment.

example.english: Technology is developing very quickly nowadays.
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 fo1 gei6 faat3 zin2 dak1 hou2 faai3

rows.note: Use this for the specific practical methods, techniques, or know-how involved in applying science in industry.

example.english: This project uses a lot of advanced technology.
example.traditional: 呢個工程要用到好多先進技術。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gung1 cing4 jiu3 jung6 dou3 hou2 do1 sin1 zeon3 gei6 seot6

rows.note: Use this when sense 1 refers specifically to tangible technology products, machines, or equipment on display or for sale.

example.english: This shop displays lots of technology products.
example.traditional: 呢間舖頭擺咗好多科技產品。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 baai2 zo2 hou2 do1 fo1 gei6 caan2 ban2
